title: D5 T=3 DRAT certificates for #1590: release assets, pins and replay script (no new claim)
body:
Follow-up to the merged #1590 (`research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas`). Its review recorded the D5 T = 3 UNSAT proof as "not shipped or replayed". This PR adds only `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas-drat/`:

- **Release assets.** The proofs are too large for repository files, so they are hosted as [release `d5-t3-drat-v1`](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds/integer-mult-bounds/releases/tag/d5-t3-drat-v1):
  - the D5 CNF, with the same sha256 as the merged package's pin, `f5e75d3b…7796`;
  - a core-trimmed DRAT proof: 109 MB zstd, 895 MB raw, independently re-checked `s VERIFIED`;
  - the original 1.71 GB kissat proof: 317 MB zstd, whose sha256 matches the merged README.
- **`fetch_and_check.sh`.** Quick mode checks downloads, hashes and the CNF pin. `FULL=1` builds drat-trim at a pinned commit and checks the core proof (about 3–6 min). `FULL=2` also checks the original proof.
- **`SHA256SUMS`** and a README.

**Recorded check:** `FULL=1`, macOS arm64: all hashes PASS, CNF pin PASS, drat-trim `s VERIFIED` in 178 s.

**Scope:** this certifies CNF unsatisfiability only. That the CNF encodes the decoder question remains the merged package's audited claim (`evidence/D5-AUDIT.md`). No change to the merged package, and no new mathematical claim.

Prepared by DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), via Claude Code; Apache-2.0.
